sources.entry: flask-admin - Simple and extensible administrative interface framework for Flask.

summary.one_liner: Flask-Admin is an extension that adds auto-generated, customizable admin interfaces with CRUD views to Flask applications.
summary.what_it_does: Flask-Admin provides tools for building admin interfaces for Flask apps, inspired by django-admin, with auto-generated CRUD views for each model that can be customized over time. According to the README it works with several ORMs, including SQLAlchemy (via Flask-SQLAlchemy or Flask-SQLAlchemy-Lite), pymongo, MongoEngine, and Peewee. It also includes a simple file management interface and a Redis client console. The README says the project uses Bootstrap, Select2, and Bootswatch for its front end. Example apps live in the examples folder, and the docs are built from .rst files with tox.
use_cases: Add an admin panel to a Flask app
Auto-generate CRUD pages for database models
Manage SQLAlchemy or MongoEngine records through a web UI
Browse and manage files through a web interface
Inspect a Redis server from a browser console
Build a customizable back-office for internal tools
notable: Auto-generated CRUD views for each model, customizable as needed
Supports multiple ORMs: SQLAlchemy, pymongo, MongoEngine, Peewee
Built-in file management interface and Redis client console
Example apps included in the examples folder
Part of the Pallets Community Ecosystem
caveats: Optional ORM support requires installing extras (e.g. uv sync --extra all for development)
Development and test setup relies on uv, tox, and Docker for full suites (Postgres, Azurite, Mongo)
